attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, which is bareheaded, short, dark brown or black, neatly slicked and parted, along with real dark eyebrows. Maintain the clean, understated upper lip and chin with a serious closed mouth; ensure the fine primary upper-lip shadow remains genuinely indistinct without inventing a prominent moustache, beard, or spectacles. Retain the dark green closed upright military collar with visible gold leaf decoration, red and gold shoulder edge, and only the actual note-limited small gold central medal and colored ribbon area. Do not add a shirt necktie or cap. The lower yellow head must be clearly rounded and short with a U-shaped bottom, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw. This head must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline with a very short, broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open or closed garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent any insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated as they appear in the source.
Keep green-ringed black eyes, actual serious closed mouth and one compact near-round yellow head.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short DARK BROWN/BLACK neatly slicked/parted hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth; fine primary upper-lip shadow genuinely indistinct, no prominent invented moustache/beard or spectacles. DARK GREEN CLOSED upright military collar with visible GOLD leaf decoration, RED/GOLD shoulder edge and only actual note-limited small gold central medal/fastening and colored ribbon area. Retain closed collar/fastening, no shirt necktie or cap. Exact primary angle/roll/light/crop remain.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed exact primary, matching larger appearance context, raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels; additional nearest-primary pixel zoom confirms the clearly exposed PALE CROSS-shaped central chest medal below gold-leaf collar beside note. Output replaced this visible medal silhouette with a plain round fastening/ribbon area and omits the cross. Separate exact-master builtin decoration repair, preserving correct dark slick-parted hair/real brows, clean serious closed mouth, closed green gold-leaf collar/red-gold shoulder edges, rounded short head/collar and opaque complete frame/backing/note. This is not an unknown fine engraving. Owner pre-call observations called it only a gold central medal/fastening and omitted the visible pale cross shape; preserve original prompt/candidate bytes and record owner omission instead of attributing unique causation to model.
